comment: The optional components of the tester release and the models offered with them.
build-release.ps1 reads this file, expands {release} in the release version, the asset names and the url
templates, and writes the result into the package as installer/components.json.
A component whose asset sha256 is not 64 hexadecimal characters has no pin: the installer refuses it with a
plain message and downloads nothing. Fill size and sha256 after the component zip is a release asset.
An asset name that carries no {release} is the literal name of the asset of one release: check it, and the
size and the sha256 with it, at every release. zip_root '*' takes the one folder the zip holds, whatever
its name, so a build folder that carries a commit needs no new name here.
The Ollama pin was read on 2026-10-11 from the built zip of scratch/llm-components/dist, which its own record
file states as well. Upload that file under this name: the name carries the Ollama version, not the release.
That zip was packed again the same day, after the client wrapper bc250-ollama.cmd and the stop of the model
runner went into the component, so size and sha256 are the ones of the 67-entry zip, not of the first one.
The llama pin was read from the published asset on 2026-10-11 (download, Get-FileHash, and the zip's own
entry list). That asset of tester.27 is uploaded again to tester.28 under the tester.28 name, with the same
bytes, so its size and sha256 do not change. The folder in the zip keeps its tester.27 name. The model pins were measured in this workspace: scratch\llm-vram\results-2026-10-10-newmodels\
model-hashes.txt and scratch\strata\models\SHA256SUMS.txt. The sizes match the Hugging Face HEAD
responses of 2026-10-11. The Ollama tags answer HTTP 200 in the registry, checked the same day.
